business_summary: Lai Sun Garment (International) Limited, an investment holding company, invests in and develops properties in Hong Kong, Mainland China, Macau, the United Kingdom, Vietnam, and internationally. It operates through Property Development and Sales, Property Investment, Hotel Operation, Restaurant and F&B Product Sales Operations, Media and Entertainment, Film and TV Program, Cinema Operation, Theme Park Operation, and Other segments. The Property Development and Sales segment develops and sells of properties. The Property Investment segment invests in commercial and office buildings. This segment also provides building management services. The Hotel Operation segment provides consultancy services to hotels and serviced apartments. The Restaurant and F&B Product Sales Operations segment operates restaurants, and sells food and beverage products. The Media and Entertainment segment engages in the management and production of concerts, and provision of related advertising services, artiste management services, album sales, the distribution and licensing of music, and the trading of gaming products. The Film and TV Program segment invests in, produces, sells, distributes, and licenses of films and TV programs. This segment also offers advertising services, and distributes video format products. The Cinema Operation segment operates cinemas. The Theme Park Operation segment develops and operates theme parks. The Others segment is involved in the yachting business, provides property management services, leasing agency, and building services. It also provides luxury yachts brokerage, charter, marketing, management, and crew placement services; and finance and treasury services, as well as engages in the golf apparel retailing, film library management, and engages in the provision of video duplication services, and translating and subtitling of television programs. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Lai Sun Garment (International) Limited는 홍콩, 중국 본토, 마카오, 영국, 베트남 및 국제적으로 부동산에 투자하고 개발합니다. 부동산 개발 및 판매, 부동산 투자, 호텔 운영, 레스토랑 및 식음료 제품 판매 운영, 미디어 및 엔터테인먼트, 영화 및 TV 프로그램, 영화관 운영, 테마파크 운영 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 부동산 개발 및 판매 부문은 부동산을 개발하고 판매합니다. 부동산 투자 부문은 상업용 건물과 사무실 건물에 투자합니다. 이 부문은 건물 관리 서비스도 제공합니다. 호텔 운영 부문은 호텔 및 서비스 아파트에 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 레스토랑 및 식음료 제품 판매 운영 부문은 레스토랑을 운영하고 식품 및 음료 제품을 판매합니다. 미디어 및 엔터테인먼트 부문은 콘서트 관리 및 제작, 관련 광고 서비스 제공, 아티스트 관리 서비스, 앨범 판매, 음악 배포 및 라이센싱, 게임 제품 거래를 담당합니다. 영화 및 TV 프로그램 부문은 다음 작품에 투자, 제작, 판매, 배포 및 라이선스를 제공합니다.
